text: compare_phylopred_slopes() fits single logistic regression genus--distance interaction quantifies uncertainty parasite-level cluster bootstrap, respects non-independence pairs share parasite. negative slope means probability sharing parasite decays faster phylogenetic distance. Lepeophtheirus slope steeper Caligus slope interaction term negative, supporting interpretation Lepeophtheirus phylogenetic specialist Caligus generalist.

what: 7. Presence-only threshold metrics: f_gamma and partial ROC
title: Comparing clades: Caligus vs Lepeophtheirus sea lice on marine fishes
text: Interaction data presence-: unrecorded host-parasite pairs unlabeled, true absences. host_threshold_metric() adapts SDM threshold metric fγ(t)=/(γb+c)f_\gamma(t) = /(\gamma b + c) phylogenies — sensitivity known hosts b fraction species phylogeny predicted hosts — phylo_partial_roc() gives Peterson-Papes-Soberon partial AUC ratio null (random-ranking) model.  gamma = 1, f_gamma can read phylogenetic efficiency: known hosts retained per unit phylogeny predicted suitable. Peterson, Papes & Soberon (2008) tolerance E bounds omission error y axis, motivated known georeferencing / identification error occurrence databases. interaction records know error, E simply omission willing tolerate; large value (E = 0.95) uses essentially whole curve, ratio compares full presence-AUC random-ranking null.
code: fit <- glm(suscept ~ phydist, data = pairs, family = binomial()) example_parasite <- names(sort(table(pairs$parasite), decreasing = TRUE))[1] one <- pairs[pairs$parasite == example_parasite, ] one$pred <- predict(fit, newdata = one, type = "response") # Suitability of each target species: best score across the parasite's # known focal hosts agg <- aggregate(cbind(pred, suscept) ~ target, data = one, FUN = max)  m <- host_threshold_metric(agg$pred, agg$suscept, gamma = 1) m #> Phylopred threshold metric f_gamma (gamma = 1) #> Optimal threshold: 0.0260  f_gamma: 1.5328 #> Evaluated at 610 thresholds. plot(m) roc <- phylo_partial_roc(agg$pred, agg$suscept, error_rate = 0.95,                          n_boot = 200, seed = 42) roc #> Phylopred phylogenetic partial ROC (E = 0.95) #> Partial AUC ratio: 1.5032 #> Bootstrap p-value (ratio <= 1): 0.0000  [200 replicates] plot(roc)

text: Partial ROC test presence-host-suitability predictions, following Peterson, Papes & Soberon (2008, Ecological Modelling 213, 63-72). ROC space redefined presence-data: y axis sensitivity \((t)\) (proportion known hosts predicted cutoff \(t\)) x axis proportion species phylogeny predicted hosts, \(b(t)\) (analogue proportional predicted area). curve restricted low-omission region \((t) \ge 1 - E\) user-chosen omission tolerance error_rate \(E\), performance summarized ratio partial AUC observed curve partial AUC null (random-ranking) expectation, diagonal \(= b\). ratio 1 equals random performance; ratios 1 indicate predictive signal. Significance assessed bootstrap resampling known hosts.

what: Poulin and Mouillot taxonomic/phylogenetic distinctness index (S_TD) — poulin_std
title: Poulin and Mouillot taxonomic/phylogenetic distinctness index (S_TD) — poulin_std
text: Computes average taxonomic (phylogenetic) distinctness \(S_{TD}\) Poulin Mouillot (2003) single parasite's known host set: $$S_{TD} = \frac{2 \sum_{<j} \omega_{ij}}{s(s-1)}$$ \(\omega_{ij}\) distance hosts \(\) \(j\) taken phydist, \(s\) number known hosts. phydist taxonomic step matrix (see taxonomic_step_matrix), \(S_{TD}\) original 1-5 taxonomic index; phydist matrix phylogenetic (patristic) distances, continuous phylogenetic generalization noted possible Poulin Mouillot (2003, Clarke Warwick, 2001), expressed directly branch-length units. corresponding sampling variance \(Var(S_{TD}) = \sum_{\ne j} (\omega_{ij} - S_{TD})^2 / [s(s-1)]\) also returned.

title: phylopred 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Clean reimplementation modern geotax workflow predicting species interactions phylogenetic distance: prepare_pair_data(), fit_phylopred_model(), compare_phylopred_slopes() — pairwise host-sharing logistic models formal slope comparison clades. bootstrap_phylopred_model(), cluster_bootstrap_phylopred(), phylopred_confidence_ellipse() — parasite-cluster bootstrap joint intercept-slope uncertainty. evaluate_phylopred_model() — McFadden/Tjur pseudo-R2, AUC, grouped cross-validated AUC. host_threshold_metric() — presence-threshold efficiency f_gamma = / (gamma * b + c) prediction threshold. phylo_partial_roc() — phylogenetic partial ROC (sensitivity vs fraction phylogeny predicted suitable) bootstrap ratio random-ranking null. fit_phylopred_pu() — positive-unlabeled host prediction xplus phylogenetic features. validate_host_prediction() — leave-hosts-validation GLM PU routes. poulin_std() — Poulin Mouillot’s (2003) average taxonomic/ phylogenetic distinctness index S_TD sampling variance, distance matrix (taxonomic steps phylogenetic distances). taxonomic_step_matrix() — builds classic 1-5 taxonomic step matrix genus/family/order/class hierarchy table. host_specificity_index() — applies poulin_std() every parasite interaction table, contrasting S_TD host_threshold_metric()’s model-based host range b*. Data: fish_tree (Fish Tree Life subtree, CC0), beetleTreeInteractions, phy_dist.
